findings.summary: Context is pushed and popped around every next(gen) chunk and again on close, re-running teardowns and match_request each time (6 teardown_appcontext calls vs 1), and loses the single deferred teardown the stream relied on
PR reads as AI-generated, and the org policy closes such PRs on sight
New test's only assertion passes on base and HEAD, so it doesn't pin the bug
No CHANGES.rst entry, which the PR template requires
Stale comments in tests/test_testing.py describe the removed push
Pre-existing: closing the response before the first chunk never calls the wrapped iterator's close()

why: Finding 1 describes pushing and popping the context around every chunk (re-running teardown and match_request each time, 6 teardowns vs 1), which is the maintainer's per-loop inefficiency complaint, and finding 2 independently names the AI-policy half.
